component.name: Maschine Linux
component.summary: Native Instruments Maschine MK3 DAW & Controller integration for Linux
DAW et intégration contrôleur Native Instruments Maschine MK3 pour Linux

description.p: Maschine Linux is a modern, ultra-low-latency Digital Audio Workstation and hardware host tailored specifically for the Native Instruments Maschine MK3 and Mikro MK3 controllers on Linux.
Maschine Linux est une station de travail audio numérique (DAW) ultra basse latence conçue spécialement pour les contrôleurs Native Instruments Maschine MK3 et Mikro MK3 sous Linux.

ul.li: Full plug-and-play hardware support for Maschine MK3 (Pads, Knobs, 4-way encoder, dual 480x272 color displays)
Integrated 808 analog drum synthesis engine and high-performance polyphonic sampler
Real-time DSP guitar multi-effects rack and Acid TB-303 synthesizer emulation
Seamless PipeWire / WirePlumber / ALSA low-latency audio support with dynamic sample-rate negotiation
Automatic in-app update mechanism from GitHub releases

description.p: Release 0.17.0 adds 16 Velocities mode (Shift + Fixed Vel), arpeggiator modes (up, down, up-down, over one or two octaves) and editing of all notes at once in Events mode.

Release 0.16.0 adds an arpeggiator to Keyboard and Chords modes (Note Repeat), writes repeated notes outside the audio thread while recording, keeps sample edits (reverse, normalize, loop) in the project, lets the Pattern screen follow queued launches, applies fixed velocity to Keyboard mode, and removes unused dependencies.

Release 0.15.0 lets every group play at once with its own synthesizer instances, fixes the meters of groups B to H, recording into groups without a pattern and SOLO, launches scenes and patterns on the next bar (marked on the screens), lights pads and group buttons with the MK3 intensities, reworks Keyboard and Chords modes like the MK3 (C3 chromatic default, octave and semitone buttons, root pads lit, in-scale chords), adds mute and solo buttons to the GUI group list, and shows startup progress on the MK3.

Release 0.14.0 adds the MK3 sample editor (record from the MK3 input, play range, slicing to pads, zone mapping) and EVENTS note editing on both screens, adds volume knob slots to the pad mixer, and documents the repository for new contributors.

Release 0.13.1 adds EQ, Chorus and Lo-Fi effects (eight effects in the plugin chain), shows the standby screen as soon as the MK3 is plugged in, adds a clickable effect chain to the GUI plugin view, and redraws the pattern grid of the MK3 screens.

Release 0.13.0 shows every plugin parameter on the MK3 screens with page navigation, adds a Maschine-style plugin chain with Filter, Distortion, Compressor, Delay and Reverb inserts on Sounds, Groups and the Master, cleans up the sound (transparent master limiter, rewritten effects, fixed guitar amp oversampling), and redesigns both the MK3 screens and the GUI around one design system.

Release 0.12.0 lays out the MK3 screens like the official controller (button labels on top, knob values at the bottom), lights buttons and LEDs from one shared state, and turns the GUI into a responsive mirror of the hardware: panels that follow the window, real knob mapping and LED-coloured pads.
Release 0.11.8 fixes guitar amp latency with small capture buffers and a bounded ring, and retunes the preamp gain staging for a clean, audible signal with gradual saturation.
Release 0.11.7 makes fixed velocity adjustable and visible on the MK3, and reorganizes the demo project into Maschine-style instrument groups (kick, snare and cymbals, synth, bass).
Release 0.11.1 keeps the guitar amp disabled by default until explicitly enabled and guarantees that pattern instruments are never routed through the amp chain.

Release 0.11.0 adds a real-time tube guitar amp on the Maschine MK3 input (four amp voices, cabinet simulation, tuner and spectrum diagnostics) with dedicated screens on both MK3 displays and contextual soft keys.

Release 0.10.5 fixes synth pad sustain so held notes sound continuously, redesigns Kick Synth BP/HP filters with analog resonance and punch, and improves Nexus Wavetable Synth filters and parameter persistence.
Release 0.10.4 fixes Master volume dropping to 0% when pressing Play on MK3 and automatically routes Pioneer DJM mixer USB channels to Channel 1.
Release 0.10.3 stabilizes USB display interface recovery and preserves system default audio output when MK3 connects.
Release 0.10.2 improves CI and release reliability with parallel quality gates, resilient AppImage downloads, cache recovery, and exact package verification.
Release 0.10.1 fixes the GNOME launcher and ensures the AppImage and standalone tarball include the same complete desktop binary as RPM and DEB.

Release 0.10.0 adds the complete MK3 Shift-pad shortcut layer to the controller and desktop pad grid, pattern Undo/Redo and event clipboard, and clearer Sound slot deletion and recovery. It also hardens settings writes and validates the declared Rust 1.88 MSRV in CI.
Release 0.9.12 routes the filter cutoff and resonance knobs to the focused synth (kick, wavetable, TB-303) when one is loaded, falling back to the sampler filter otherwise.
Release 0.9.11 unifies the multimode sampler filter (low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, off) with the synth paths and restores the last opened project at startup.
Release 0.9.10 splits the hardware mapper into focused handlers, adds 8 groups with 128 independent tracks, universal filter shortcuts, sustained pad notes, and a cleaner AppImage restart.
Release 0.9.9 adds direct low-pass, high-pass, band-pass and off filter soft keys, aligns Shift soft-key labels with hardware dispatch, and starts the MK3 reverse-engineering guide.

Release 0.9.8 brings authentic Maschine MK3 pattern toggle-off, multi-pad pattern chaining, dynamic real-time Shift labels on display buttons with contextual actions, improved 4D mixer navigation (Up to drill into group, Down to return), per-pad synth/sampler mixer volume isolation, full Nexus/Wavetable synth knob controls, latchable Note Repeat with rate selection, and hardware LED state fixes.

Release 0.9.7 adds Wavetable/Nexus Synth plugin with 28 factory presets, Kick Synth FM/drive/filter enhancements, 4D mixer pad drill-down with live pad VU meters, quick filter selection, and automatic exiting of latched modes from top-row buttons.
Release 0.9.6 adds Kick Synth modeler plugin, MK3 per-pad mixer controls, realtime DSP effects chains, Browser plugins/effects selection, project deletion from MK3, and restart improvements.
Release 0.9.5 fixes MK3 FILE/SAVE and BROWSER LED mapping, restores full New Project creation workflow, and corrects MK3 screen softkeys.
Release 0.9.4 adds a NEW project soft key to the MK3 FILE project browser.
Release 0.9.3 corrects the MK3 FILE/SAVE and BROWSER physical button mapping and updates on-screen guidance.
Release 0.9.2 restores MK3 project browser access, improves mute pad LED visibility, and adds a restart button after auto-update.

Release 0.9.1 fixes MK3 FILE SAVE/project browser workflow with visible save feedback, adds Maschine-style per-pad mute with dimmed LEDs, and records Keyboard/Chords performances with actual MIDI pitch during REC.

Release 0.9.0 adds a Maschine-style FILE/project workflow on MK3 and GUI, per-pad volume and pan editing for every Sound in each Group, and repaired Keyboard/Chords modes with scale, root, octave, chord controls and dedicated screens.
Release 0.8.0 with complete Pattern management, hideable workspace and MK3 panels, and a graceful MK3 shutdown that restores the default logo and turns pad LEDs off.
Release 0.7.0 with latched MK3 navigation, a unified PLUGIN page, simplified TB-303 controls, per-Sound polyphony and choke, a responsive desktop GUI, and a standalone --no-hardware mode.
Release 0.6.0 with GUI studio interface, 808 analog synthesis, dual-screen mirror, PipeWire low latency and hotplug support.
